description: Compositions du trafic à Paris is a dataset listed in Paris Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by DVD. L'Observatoire de la mobilité réalise depuis 1997 une composition du trafic sur une dizaine de voies dans Pairs Intra-Muros, 4 voies sur le boulevard périphérique et 4 sur le boulevard des Maréchaux. ces enquêtes sont réalisées sur 3 jours en novembre entre 7 heures et 21 heures. Coverage: Paris. The portal files it under Mobilité et Espace Public. Its keywords are vélos, composition du trafic, poids lourds, 2RM. The portal shows 14,199 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-03-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-paris-fr-portal.
